tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Lightweight liveness probe for the constelarcumbaya.com platform.

tools.name: list_clips
tools.description: List the Family Constellations video clips (id + Spanish/English title). Use this when someone asks what videos or constellation examples are available.

tools.name: list_therapies
tools.description: List the therapy modalities offered (family constellations, individual sessions, etc.) with a short description of each. Use this when someone asks what we do or what a session is.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the problems family constellations help with (grief, couples, anxiety, addiction, money, illness, adoption, estrangement, conflict, parent relationships). Use this when someone asks whether constellations help with a specific issue.

tools.name: get_workshop
tools.description: Details of the upcoming family-constellations workshop (name, date, time, venue, facilitators, price to participate vs. to constellate, and the schedule). Use this when someone asks about the next workshop or event.

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: The facilitator training program levels, prices, and what each level includes. Use this when someone asks about learning to facilitate constellations or the training program.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Session formats and their prices (individual, couples, etc.). Use this when someone asks how much a session costs.

tools.name: get_free_lesson
tools.description: A free introduction to what family constellations are and how a session works, step by step. Use this to teach someone the basics before they book: the three orders (belonging, order, balance), the session steps, and what is asked of the participant.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.description: List the frequently asked questions and answers about family constellations. Use this when someone asks a general question about how constellations work, what to expect, or practical details.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: How to book: the free 15-minute introductory call (Calendly), the WhatsApp keyword (CONSTELAR), and the steps. Use this when someone wants to book a session or workshop — do not invent a link; relay the Calendly/WhatsApp options returned here.
